firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently saw an acrobat starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The separate UK-flagged English publisher file uses seeing a stage instead. These are distinct source editions; check the manual supplied with your game.
